e05e1bf64a1b7af8.description: Job description About the job E&I ENGINEER (CS) We are seeking an experienced E&I Engineer (Construction Support – CS) with 5–10 years of experience in marine and shipbuilding projects. Review, prepare, and revise E&I engineering deliverables, including: Electrical equipment layout and installation drawings Cable routing, cable tray, and cable ladder layouts Cable schedules, termination diagrams, and interconnection drawings Lighting, power distribution, and small power layouts Instrument location and installation drawings Instrument hook-up drawings and installation details Junction box layouts and cable termination details Earthing and bonding layouts Equipment mounting, supports, and installation arrangements 2D production drawings and 3D models for E&I systems Review shop drawings, installation drawings, and production information to identify discrepancies and resolve design-related issues. Provide technical support to shipyard production teams during electrical equipment installation, cable pulling, cable termination, instrument mounting, and system integration activities. Resolve technical queries (TQs), site and production issues, drawing discrepancies, and installation-related engineering problems. Coordinate with Hull Structure, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, and other engineering disciplines to ensure proper E&I integration and avoid clashes. Review vendor drawings, equipment specifications, cable requirements, and technical documentation to ensure compatibility with vessel arrangements and installation requirements. Verify cable routing, equipment accessibility, installation clearances, maintenance access, and interface requirements before execution. Support constructability reviews and identify potential installation constraints, routing conflicts, and design discrepancies. Ensure E&I installation arrangements comply with project specifications, applicable marine standards, classification society requirements, and shipyard construction procedures. Coordinate with electrical and instrumentation engineers, designers, equipment vendors, and production personnel to ensure timely resolution of technical issues. Support the preparation and updating of cable schedules, equipment lists, material lists, and installation documentation, where required. Assist in resolving issues related to equipment positioning, cable tray routing, penetrations, supports, and interfaces with structural and mechanical systems. Ensure construction support deliverables are completed within agreed project schedules and quality requirements. KEY QUALIFICATIONS: Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or an equivalent engineering discipline. 5–10 years of relevant experience in E&I engineering or construction support within marine, shipbuilding, shipyard, or offshore vessel projects. Strong experience in electrical and instrumentation installation layouts, cable routing, equipment positioning, and associated engineering activities. Good understanding of marine electrical systems, power distribution, lighting, earthing, cable management, instrumentation installation, and control system interfaces. Experience preparing and modifying 2D production drawings, cable schedules, installation drawings, and 3D models. Proficiency in marine 3D design software, preferably AVEVA Marine / Hull & Outfitting, or other shipbuilding CAD software accepted by the client. Ability to interpret engineering drawings, electrical schematics, instrument hook-up drawings, cable schedules, vendor documentation, and production mark-ups. Experience resolving technical queries and supporting shipyard production teams during construction and installation activities. Experience coordinating with Hull Structure, Machinery Outfitting, Piping, HVAC, and other engineering disciplines. Strong technical problem-solving, drawing interpretation, coordination, and communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a project-driven engineering and shipyard production environment. The Role of Principal Piping Engineer Worley Parsons is seeking a Principal Piping Engineer for a full-time position in Al Khobar. This role involves acting as a Subject Matter Expert for piping dynamic stress analysis and vibration engineering, contributing to projects from FEED through to commissioning and site troubleshooting. Key Responsibilities Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for piping dynamic stress analysis and vibration engineering. Perform and review dynamic and static piping stress analysis using CAESAR II or equivalent software. Assess piping systems for natural frequency, resonance, mode shapes, dynamic stresses, and fatigue analysis. Analyze dynamic loads from pumps, compressors, reciprocating equipment, PSV/PRV, pulsation, and transient events. Evaluate water hammer, steam hammer, slug flow, FIV, and AIV, and recommend mitigation measures. Review piping layouts and identify systems requiring dynamic analysis and vibration assessment. Design and optimize dynamic supports, guides, anchors, snubbers, and restraints. Evaluate dynamic forces and moments transferred to supports, structures, and connected equipment. Check equipment nozzle loads against applicable project, vendor, and industry requirements. Investigate piping vibration and dynamic integrity issues and perform root-cause analysis. Recommend practical engineering solutions for excessive vibration, resonance, and fatigue. Review piping stress calculations, reports, isometrics, layouts, and support drawings prepared by engineers. Develop and review piping stress and dynamic analysis methodologies, criteria, and procedures. Ensure compliance with applicable ASME, API, project specifications, and client standards. Coordinate with process, mechanical, rotating equipment, structural, instrumentation, and operations teams. Review vendor data related to equipment excitation forces, pulsation, vibration, and nozzle loads. Provide technical support during FEED, detailed engineering, construction, commissioning, and site troubleshooting. Lead technical reviews and provide SME input during design/model reviews, HAZOPs, and client meetings. Mentor piping stress engineers and perform technical/quality reviews of engineering deliverables. Support resolution of technical queries, deviations, site issues, and engineering optimization related to piping dynamic stress. Work Environment and Culture Worley is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong and can thrive. The company fosters a values-inspired culture focused on belonging, connection, and innovation to drive sustainable impact. Worley supports the reskilling of its workforce and the transition to expertise in low-carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

e09850261e6dc326.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن مشرف تنظيف وتدبير للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على أنشطة التدبير في المرافق التجارية وتنسيقها وتنفيذها، لضمان الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب المرافق. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الجدول الزمني لخدمات التنظيف والتدبير. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية الخاصة بأعمال الموظفين وتحضيرها. الإشراف المباشر على الموظفين أثناء أداء واجباتهم، والتي تشمل مسح الأتربة وكنس الأرضيات وتنظيف دورات المياه وتغيير الشراشف. الحث على تنفيذ سياسات وإجراءات التدبير المنزلي المعتمدة. مراقبة مخزون إمدادات التنظيف والمعدات والإمدادات الأخرى، والحفاظ عليه لضمان توفرها. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المحددة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الإشراف على التنظيف والتدبير. القدرة على إدارة وتنسيق فرق العمل بفعالية. معرفة جيدة بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة نجران، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة سراكو. يتطلب الدور التزامًا بالحفاظ على معايير عالية من النظافة والترتيب في المرافق التجارية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عملنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لتحديد الخطوات التالية.

e09d585a2d134f0e.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة محمد عبدالله آل طالب وشركاه للتجارة والزراعة عن حاجتها لأمين صندوق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، الخرج. يتولى أمين الصندوق مسؤولية الإدارة المالية والتخطيط، مع التركيز على إدارة التدفقات النقدية والسيولة والتمويل. يشمل الدور إجراء تحليلات دقيقة للسيولة وأسعار الفائدة والعملات والمخاطر المرتبطة بها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الأرصدة النقدية اليومية وتحليل التدفق النقدي من العمليات والاستثمار والتمويل، لضمان كفاية التدفقات النقدية. توقع المدفوعات النقدية والتنبؤ بالمشكلات المحتملة الناتجة عن محدودية التدفق النقدي. تحليل متطلبات رأس المال في العمليات التجارية والمعاملات والالتزامات الأخرى. تقديم الدعم في تطوير سياسات وإجراءات الرقابة الداخلية المتعلقة بإدارة الموازنة والنقد والائتمان والمحاسبة. تحليل وإدارة المخاطر المرتبطة بالتدفقات النقدية، وإجراء تحليل الحساسية لتقييم تقلبات التدفقات النقدية فيما يتعلق بالمخاطر التشغيلية والتمويلية. تحليل وتحديد خيارات وشروط التمويل المناسبة للاحتياجات التشغيلية والاستثمارية، والسعي للحصول على مصادر التمويل والتفاوض بشأن شروطها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على إدارة التدفقات النقدية والسيولة بكفاءة. مهارات تحليلية قوية في تقييم المخاطر المالية. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بالمهام والمسؤوليات المحددة. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الخرج، الرياض. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

e04ffed95c4d3e97.description: About KEO International Consultants KEO International Consultants is a creative enterprise providing end-to-end services in planning, design, and project delivery for built and natural environments. With over 60 years of experience, KEO has contributed to significant projects globally. The firm is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms, and by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. Attend site meetings and provide regular updates on progress, issues, and risks. Coordinate interfaces between civil works and other disciplines for smooth project delivery. Review contractor submissions and provide technical input. Support the Project Manager and senior leadership in achieving project objectives. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in construction management. Demonstrated experience managing multiple buildings or towers concurrently, preferably within hospitality or mixed-use developments. Strong technical background in MEP systems, coordination, testing, commissioning, and integrated systems delivery. Experience leading and managing construction delivery of a cluster of mid-rise hotel towers from mobilization through testing, commissioning, handover, and close-out. Ability to provide overall leadership to construction, MEP, architectural, structural, logistics, quality, and safety teams across a project cluster. Proficiency in coordinating civil, structural, architectural, façade, MEP, and specialist hotel systems for integrated project delivery. Expertise in overseeing installation, coordination, testing, and commissioning of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, ELV, and building management systems. Experience in establishing and managing construction strategy, sequencing, site logistics, access arrangements, and deployment of resources. Capability to monitor construction progress against baseline programs and implement corrective measures. Skill in identifying constraints, interface issues, and potential delays early and coordinating their timely resolution. Experience chairing construction, coordination, progress, and interface meetings with various stakeholders. Ability to manage interfaces between structural works, building envelope, architectural finishes, MEP services, and hotel operational systems. Proficiency in overseeing technical submittals, shop drawings, material approvals, and procurement schedules. Experience in monitoring contractor and subcontractor performance, resource deployment, and productivity. Strong oversight of health, safety, environmental, and welfare requirements. Experience in managing phased completion, snagging, statutory approvals, and handover activities. Ability to support the assessment of variations, claims, and extension-of-time matters. Skill in preparing accurate progress reports, executive updates, and risk assessments. Experience in mentoring and managing construction managers, MEP managers, and site supervision personnel. The focus is on safely delivering this landmark hospitality development on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are invited to apply for this full-time position.

Support project teams from the tender stage through execution and final account settlement. Strengthen commercial governance and improve margin visibility across the project portfolio. Manage senior commercial teams and interface with clients, consultants, and legal advisors. Contribute to bid strategy and contract structuring. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will possess extensive commercial leadership experience within construction or infrastructure environments. A strong background in contract management, claims, and project financials is essential for this role. Experience working on large-scale Saudi projects is highly preferred. Qualifications and Requirements Over 10 years of commercial leadership experience in construction or infrastructure. Demonstrated expertise in contract management, claims, and project financials. Strong negotiation skills and risk awareness. Ability to support complex project environments. Chartered or professionally qualified candidates are strongly preferred. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates within a dynamic environment focused on major construction and infrastructure projects. The Commercial Director will work with project teams, executive leadership, and external stakeholders. Application Process Foreground is managing the recruitment for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

e00d96c018b9f5f3.description: About the Premier Resident Engineer Role Extreme Networks, a leader in Enterprise Cloud Networking, is seeking an experienced Premier Resident Engineer (PRE) to join its Premier Support Delivery Organization. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and involves providing enhanced post-sale support to customers who have purchased the white glove program, which extends beyond their standard maintenance contract. The PRE offers technical guidance, recommendations, issue escalation support, and consultation for Extreme Network products used by designated customers. Key Responsibilities Provide technical support to Extreme Networks Premier customers, with a focus on wireless, edge, campus, and cloud product portfolios, specifically supporting Extreme Cloud IQ. Manage case handling, perform first-line troubleshooting, act as an escalation point for customer first-level engineers, and engage with Extreme GTAC for situation control and resolution. Assist third-party maintainers (TPM) with hardware replacements as needed. Utilize mature network management and troubleshooting skills to understand, diagnose, and resolve customer issues on Extreme equipment. Define, manage, and execute problem resolution plans, communicating closure and resolution to Extreme customer support, Premier Delivery Manager (PDM), partners, and customers. Serve as a resource for maintenance, tuning, and proactive planning to maintain the health and optimization of client’s Extreme environments. Manage problem resolution, upgrades, and involvement in complex situations. Participate in weekly support meetings and provide regular status reporting on projects and proactive support tasks. Effectively manage multiple tasks simultaneously. Configure and provide guidance on the ExtremeCloud IQ direction. Utilize diagnostic aids, tools, and appropriate lab equipment as necessary. Acquire and maintain extensive knowledge of Extreme products and their integration into the cloud strategy. Pursue technical training paths and industry certifications to enhance delivery capabilities. Required Qualifications and Experience Between 5 to 10 years of experience in a relevant technical support or engineering role. Demonstrated expertise in network management and troubleshooting. Strong understanding of wireless, edge, campus, and cloud networking technologies. Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment, prioritizing transparency, candor, curiosity, ownership, and inclusion. Work Schedule and Travel The standard work schedule is Sunday to Thursday, 8 AM to 5 PM local time, or as agreed upon with the customer and Extreme Networks. Flexibility for last-minute and planned travel requirements, including after-hours and weekends, is necessary. The position is primarily onsite with the customer, with limited travel possible (less than 20%) or as agreed. Compensation The salary for this position ranges from 290,000 to 320,000 SAR.

e0b0eeaa8601226b.description: About the Role The Luxury Collection is seeking a Mgr Purchasing to join their team in Ad Diriyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing established procedures for purchasing, receiving, storing, issuing, and payment of goods, ensuring compliance with company standards and financial objectives. Key Responsibilities Manage cross-departmental purchasing work, projects, policies, and standards, including generating accurate reports and presentations. Assist the Executive Office with all aspects of purchasing, particularly for food, beverage, and controllable projects, to ensure quality and profitability. Order all food and beverage items based on business needs and assist in maintaining/reducing budgeted costs. Implement and execute the first-in, first-out inventory rotation principle for all storeroom products. Ensure compliance with sanitation and safety standards, and maintain effective security procedures for storeroom assets. Collaborate with storeroom personnel and kitchen management to optimize inventory levels and minimize waste. Communicate with kitchen and restaurant management and vendors to ensure timely deliveries meet production needs. Inspect all received goods against invoices to verify quantities, quality, weights, and purchase specifications. Perform daily and period-end food and beverage cost calculations using existing computer programs. Maintain accurate inventory control, including dating, rotation, and requisitions, and complete period-end inventory counts. Manage invoices accurately and ensure proper filing procedures are followed. Provide guidance and assistance to other organizational units on accounting budget policies and procedures. Coordinate and implement assigned accounting work and projects, including audits in all areas of hotel operations. Support hotel operations by reviewing performance data, identifying areas for improvement, and ensuring compliance with brand strategies. Maintain a professional and courteous demeanor, providing excellent customer service to all guests and internal stakeholders. Support profitability by reviewing financial statements and other performance data to identify cost reduction opportunities. Implement and maintain the hotel's emergency plan, accident prevention plan, and ensure a safe work environment. Qualifications and Requirements A four-year bachelor's degree in Finance and Accounting or a related major. 5-10 years of relevant experience in purchasing or a related field. Demonstrated knowledge of job-related issues, products, systems, and processes. Proficiency in using computers and computer systems, including hardware and software, for data entry and processing. Ability to use relevant information and judgment to ensure compliance with laws, regulations, or standards. Strong interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others. Excellent organizational abilities and time management skills. Professional Skills Ability to analyze information and evaluate results to choose optimal solutions and solve problems. Capacity to keep up-to-date technically and apply new knowledge to job functions. Demonstrated honesty and integrity, leading by example. Confidence, energy, and enthusiasm in professional interactions. Skill in managing small group or interpersonal conflicts effectively. Ability to present ideas, expectations, and information concisely and in an organized manner. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Ad Diriyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring active engagement with various departments, vendors, and the Executive Office. The role involves maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring operational efficiency within a luxury hospitality setting. Application Process Candidates who meet the qualifications and are prepared to contribute to a dynamic purchasing environment are encouraged to apply.

e0cff03901bcf139.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركه منبع التصافي عن فني صيانة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على ضمان الأداء الفعال للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية من خلال تشخيص الأعطال وتنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الميكانيكية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية لتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وتحديد أسبابها. تقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والأجهزة والمعدات الميكانيكية وفقاً للجداول الزمنية المحددة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منهجي. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال صيانة المعدات الميكانيكية. القدرة على قراءة وتتبع المخططات الميكانيكية. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال وتحديد أسبابها. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. الموقع جدة، مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

e0dda07237eab4d5.description: About the Role Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Chef de Cuisine for a Fusion Restaurant in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This full-time role is responsible for the quality, consistency, and production of the restaurant kitchen. The Chef de Cuisine will lead staff, manage food-related functions, and coordinate menus, purchasing, staffing, and food preparation while ensuring guest and employee satisfaction within budget. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Develop, design, and create new culinary applications, ideas, and products for the restaurant. Supervise restaurant kitchen shift operations, ensuring compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards, and procedures. Maintain proper food preparation, handling, and storage standards. Plan and manage food quantities and plating requirements, communicating production needs to key personnel. Assist in developing daily and seasonal menu items for the restaurant. Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, including proper handling and temperature of food products. Estimate daily restaurant production needs and prepare/cook various food types for guests or special functions. Check the quality of raw and cooked food products and determine presentation, including decorative food displays. Leadership and Team Management Supervise and coordinate activities of cooks and other food preparation staff. Lead shift teams, personally preparing food items and executing requests based on specifications. Manage all day-to-day restaurant kitchen operations and understand employee positions to perform duties in their absence. Encourage mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members, serving as a role model. Ensure and maintain employee productivity levels and cross-training for successful daily operations. Establish and maintain open, collaborative relationships with employees. Operational Goals and Standards Set and support the achievement of kitchen goals, including performance, budget, and team objectives. Develop specific guidance and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish daily kitchen operations. Understand the impact of kitchen operations on overall property financial goals and manage to achieve or exceed budgeted targets. Investigate, report, and follow up on employee accidents, and implement company safety standards. Customer Service Excellence Manage day-to-day operations to ensure quality, standards, and customer expectations are met. Improve service by communicating guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and coaching. Set a positive example for guest relations and emphasize guest satisfaction in departmental meetings. Empower employees to provide excellent customer service and handle guest problems and complaints. Interact with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels. Human Resources and Development Identify developmental needs of others and provide coaching, mentoring, or assistance to improve knowledge and skills. Participate in training restaurant staff on menu items, including ingredients, preparation methods, and tastes. Manage employee progressive discipline procedures and participate in performance appraisals. Utilize available on-the-job training tools for employees. Assist in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with appropriate skills.

e045e25dd44e6199.description: About the Role Currie & Brown is seeking an Associate Director Project Controls to join our team in Riyadh, KSA. This full-time position involves leading the Project Controls elements within a Project Management Office (PMO) for a multi-billion SAR gigaproject. The role focuses on providing strategic leadership and ensuring best practices across a large-scale development portfolio. Key Responsibilities The Associate Director – Project Controls will be responsible for leading, governing, and continuously improving all project controls functions. This includes providing strategic oversight for various critical areas: Leading and governing project controls functions across a large-scale development portfolio. Providing strategic leadership for planning, scheduling, and reporting. Overseeing governance, performance management, and project controls assurance. Administering PMIS (Project Management Information System) and business intelligence reporting. Ensuring programme-wide compliance with established standards. Acting as the client's senior subject matter expert for project controls. Establishing best-practice standards and maintaining governance frameworks. e026aabe19d7793b.description: مطلوب مطوّر ومصمّم ألعاب للعمل عن بُعد نجوم كرافتريا هي لعبة ويب تعتمد على إطلاق الكرات وتجاوز العوائق وجمع النجوم في مراحل متنوعة ومتدرجة الصعوبة. نعمل على تطوير تجربة لعب ممتعة وتصاميم جذابة ومتناسقة على الجوال والآيباد والكمبيوتر، ونرغب في ضم مطوّر لديه خبرة في برمجة الألعاب وتصميم واجهاتها وتنفيذها باحترافية داخل اللعبة. المهام الوظيفية: • تطوير برمجة اللعبة وإضافة مراحل وميزات جديدة. • ضبط حركة الكرات والتصويب والتصادمات ومعالجة الأخطاء التقنية. • تصميم واجهات اللعبة وصفحاتها وعناصرها البصرية وتنفيذها بما يتناسب مع هويتها. • ضبط التصاميم على مختلف مقاسات الشاشات، مع مراعاة أحجام العناصر وأماكنها وسهولة استخدامها باللمس والماوس. • اختبار اللعبة على الجوال والآيباد والكمبيوتر والمتصفحات المختلفة. • تحسين سرعة التحميل والأداء وسلاسة اللعب. • تطوير الحسابات وحفظ تقدم اللاعبين وربط قواعد البيانات وحماية الوصول إليها. • تنظيم الكود وتوثيق التعديلات وتسليم الملفات المصدرية للكود والتصاميم. المتطلبات: • خبرة فعلية في تطوير ألعاب الويب، مع أعمال سابقة قابلة للتجربة. • القدرة على تصميم واجهات الألعاب وتنفيذها، مع الاهتمام بالتفاصيل وجودة تجربة المستخدم. • مهارة في اكتشاف المشكلات وحلها واختبار التعديلات قبل نشرها. • الالتزام بالمواعيد والتواصل المستمر وتقديم تحديثات واضحة عن الإنجاز. • الالتزام بسرية المشروع وحقوق الملكية. للتقديم: يرجى إرسال نبذة عن الخبرة، ونماذج الأعمال السابقة، وتوضيح دورك في تنفيذها، والتقنيات التي تتقنها ومدى تفرغك.

e02481f86b0eb61e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ادارة الاعمال عن أخصائي إدارة مخاطر للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى المساهمة في تطوير وتنفيذ سياسات وإجراءات إدارة المخاطر، مع التركيز بشكل خاص على مخاطر الأمن السيبراني. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى أخصائي إدارة المخاطر مسؤولية تحديد وتحليل وتقييم مخاطر الأمن السيبراني، بالإضافة إلى تطوير وتنفيذ الخطط اللازمة لمعالجتها. يشمل ذلك إعداد التقارير الدورية وتقديم التوصيات لضمان استمرارية الأعمال. المهام والواجبات التواصل الفعال مع الإدارة العليا والإدارات المعنية بشأن مخاطر الأمن السيبراني وآليات معالجتها. ضمان إعداد الخطط والتدابير اللازمة للتعامل مع مخاطر الأمن السيبراني وفق السياسات والضوابط المعتمدة. تحديد وتحليل مخاطر الأمن السيبراني على أصول وأنظمة الجهة. إجراء تقييم دوري للمخاطر، خاصة عند حدوث تغييرات جوهرية على الأنظمة أو البرامج. تقديم التوصيات المتعلقة بقبول المخاطر أو معالجتها أو الحد منها. المساهمة في تأسيس نموذج حوكمة فعال وضمان الالتزام بالسياسات الوطنية للأمن السيبراني. مراجعة وتقييم الوضع الحالي للجهة وتحديد فرص التحسين والتطوير. متابعة وتحديث سجل المخاطر بشكل مستمر وفق المستجدات. إعداد وتطوير إطار عمل تقييم مخاطر الأمن السيبراني لمختلف الإدارات. تطوير وتحديث السياسات والإجراءات الداخلية المتعلقة بإدارة المخاطر السيبرانية. إعداد وتنفيذ خطط معالجة المخاطر المحتملة والحد من آثارها. نشر الوعي بمخاطر الأمن السيبراني وتعزيز ثقافة إدارة المخاطر داخل الجهة. إعداد التقارير الدورية الخاصة بتقييم وإدارة المخاطر. تقديم حلول عملية للمشكلات التي قد تؤثر على استمرارية الأعمال. تنفيذ أي مهام أخرى ذات صلة حسب متطلبات العمل أو توجيهات المدير المباشر. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة المخاطر. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ إجراءات إدارة المخاطر باستخدام الأساليب النوعية والكمية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير وعرضها. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة تبوك. سيعمل المرشح ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في تعزيز الأمن السيبراني وحوكمة المخاطر. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة ادارة الاعمال.

e042bf5c230692db.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رواق للمسارات المتقدمة عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على وضع سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم النتائج، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المتخصصة في مجال المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات السوق لتحديد وتطوير الأهداف التسويقية وطرق البيع. تقدير حجم المبيعات المتوقع وترجمة الأهداف إلى خطط بيعية قابلة للتنفيذ. اقتراح سياسات البيع ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى وضع وتقييم البرامج الترويجية. التواصل الفعال مع العملاء لتحديد مشكلاتهم ومتابعة المنافسين وبرامجهم البيعية لتجنب المخاطر المستقبلية. تقييم أداء مندوبي البيع ومدى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية، واقتراح الخطط والإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالمبيعات، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على تحليل السوق وتحديد الأهداف البيعية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل وبناء العلاقات مع العملاء. القدرة على إعداد وتقديم التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل أخصائي المبيعات ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق الأهداف البيعية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

e06d218aee558587.description: About the Role STYRO 3D is seeking a technically strong CAD Draftsman to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves preparing accurate fabrication, production, and installation drawings for custom architectural, scenic, exhibition, event, and 3D fabrication projects. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of experience and a strong understanding of manufacturing and installation processes. Role Context The CAD Draftsman will play a crucial role in translating designs into production-ready technical drawings. This position requires close collaboration with various teams, including Project Managers, Designers, Production, CNC/Robotics, Steel, Carpentry, GRP/Fiberglass, Electrical, and Site Installation teams, ensuring that designs are not only drawn correctly but are also practical for manufacturing and installation. Key Responsibilities Prepare detailed 2D CAD drawings, shop drawings, fabrication drawings, and installation drawings from approved concepts, 3D models, sketches, and site information. Convert architectural and creative designs into production-ready technical drawings. Produce plans, elevations, sections, details, exploded views, assembly drawings, and fixing details. Generate accurate dimensions and fabrication details for various materials and components, including steel structures, timber, EPS/Styrofoam, GRP/Fiberglass, Polyurea, CNC/robotic-cut components, ACP, acrylic, signage, decorative cladding, exhibition stands, and scenic installations. Prepare steel connection, base plate, anchoring, support, and fixing details in coordination with technical and structural teams. Break down complex designs into practical components suitable for factory production, transportation, assembly, and site installation. Prepare drawings showing material thicknesses, profiles, dimensions, quantities, fixing methods, and finishes. Coordinate with the CNC/Robotics team to ensure drawings and files are suitable for machine production and assist in optimizing material utilization. Review designer/client drawings to identify missing dimensions, technical conflicts, or impractical fabrication details. Coordinate drawing revisions based on production feedback, site conditions, and client comments. Conduct site measurements when required and convert them into accurate technical drawings. Prepare as-built drawings following project completion. Maintain proper drawing numbering, revision control, file organization, and project documentation. Support estimation and production teams with dimensions, areas, quantities, and material take-offs. Coordinate continuously with the factory to resolve technical issues during fabrication. Ensure drawings clearly communicate required information to fabricators, supervisors, subcontractors, and installation teams. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience as a CAD Draftsman. Previous experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred: Event fabrication Exhibition stands Scenic fabrication Architectural fabrication Signage Interior fit-out Steel fabrication GRP / Fiberglass production Theme parks or entertainment projects Custom 3D fabrication Compensation The salary for this position ranges from SAR 3,750 to SAR 5,625 per month. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time CAD Draftsman position in Riyadh.

e09be0b985a68802.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ارسان الجزيرة للصيانة والتشغيل عن مدير عمليات تشغيل للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الحدود الشمالية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف المباشر على تخطيط وتنظيم وتشغيل المعدات المختلفة، مع ضمان الكفاءة والفعالية القصوى للعمليات. الهدف من الوظيفة المشاركة في إعداد الخطط الاستراتيجية والتشغيلية لعمليات التشغيل، والإشراف على تخطيط وتنظيم تشغيل المعدات المتنوعة. يتضمن الدور متابعة تنفيذ التعليمات بما يتوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية، وضمان توفر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية عالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في إعداد الخطط الاستراتيجية والأهداف العامة بما يتماشى مع التوجهات والأولويات المحددة، والمساهمة في إدارة وتوجيه وتقييم عمليات التطبيق. متابعة وإدارة وتوجيه الأنشطة المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات، وضمان التطبيق الأمثل للأنظمة واللوائح والتعليمات والتوجيهات. متابعة عمليات إصدار التراخيص والتصاريح بما يتوافق مع المعايير والشروط المعتمدة. المشاركة في مراجعة وتطوير الأنظمة واللوائح والسياسات المتبعة في مجالات تشغيل المعدات، وضمان تحديثها المستمر. مراجعة ودراسة احتياجات المملكة من الخطوط الحديدية فيما يتعلق بالمعدات. متابعة عمليات إعداد وتحضير تقارير العمل والإنجاز، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا المتخصصة، وإحاطتها بالتحديات والمستجدات المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات المختلفة، واستشارتهم في القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بعمليات التشغيل. القدرة على إعداد الخطط الاستراتيجية والتشغيلية. مهارات قوية في الإشراف والتنظيم والمتابعة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في منطقة الحدود الشمالية، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب الالتزام بالخطط التشغيلية والمعايير المحددة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل التوظيف.

e09d00022d1a72dd.description: About the Role IHG Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Commercial Director (Cluster) for Six Senses Amaala in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing the commercial operations across Six Senses Amaala and Six Senses Southern Dunes, ensuring alignment with the Six Senses vision and values, which prioritize sustainability, wellness, and unique guest experiences. Role Overview The Cluster Commercial Director will be responsible for the efficient operation of the Sales & Marketing department for both Six Senses Amaala and Six Senses Southern Dunes. This includes providing products and services that meet Six Senses brand operating standards and budget. The role requires strategic collaboration with the General Managers of both properties to develop and achieve cohesive commercial goals. Key Responsibilities Maintain overall consistency of the company’s vision, quality, and standards, and develop commercial concepts aligned with brand identity across both properties. Collaborate with General Managers, the Executive team, and operations on product standards to deliver guest service results. Lead, develop, and manage the cluster Sales, Marketing, Revenue Management, and Public Relations teams for Six Senses Amaala and Six Senses Southern Dunes. Develop and execute the cluster commercial strategy, annual sales and marketing plan, and revenue budget for both properties. Set and monitor commercial performance targets, including RevPAR, market share, and profitability, in conjunction with the Director of Finance. Build and maintain relationships with key accounts, travel partners, luxury consortia, and DMCs to drive business for both resorts. Represent Six Senses Amaala and Six Senses Southern Dunes at trade shows, sales trips, and industry events. Oversee pricing, distribution, and channel strategy to maximize revenue and profitability across both properties. Partner with the global Six Senses Sales & Marketing team on brand campaigns, positioning, and pre-opening commercial readiness. Ensure properties operate consistent with all legal, statutory, and financial requirements, including reporting systems, contractual obligations, security, safety protocols, and budgetary controls. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for the Cluster Commercial Director position must possess the following: Over 10 years of experience in a similar commercial role within luxury hotels. Proven track record of results in a comparable position. Required technical skills relevant to the role. Company Vision The successful candidate will be expected to uphold the Six Senses vision of helping people reconnect with themselves, others, and the world. This includes safeguarding the pillars of sustainability, wellness, and out-of-the-ordinary experiences through strategic planning and development, ensuring all directives and initiatives are implemented across both properties. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the application process.

e0aeab7e35f8dbb6.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مكتب د علي صالح الدهيمان للاستشارات البيئيه عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقه في بريدة، القصيم. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. يركز شاغل الوظيفة على مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتطوير إجراءات العمل، ومعالجة المشكلات التشغيلية. الغرض من الوظيفة تتمثل المهمة الأساسية لمراقب الخدمات العامة في ضمان سير العمليات اليومية بسلاسة وفعالية. يشمل ذلك الإشراف على أداء فريق الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم، وتطوير برامج عمل تهدف إلى تحسين الكفاءة التشغيلية، بالإضافة إلى تقييم الأداء وتقديم الدعم اللازم لتنمية المهارات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال ونشاطات موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بناءً على حجم وأولويات العمل وقدرات العاملين. إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل، وتنسيق النشاطات مع الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى ذات الصلة. دراسة مشكلات العمل، وتحديد أسبابها، واقتراح بدائل الحلول الممكنة، واختيار الحل الأنسب، ومتابعة التنفيذ والتقييم. تقييم أداء موظفي الخدمات العامة ومدى التزامهم باللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بمجال العمل. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية الفردية للموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على مراجعة وتنسيق الأعمال وتحديد المهام بفعالية. مهارات في إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات واقتراح الحلول المناسبة. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. بيئة العمل يعمل مراقب الخدمات العامة ضمن فريق عمل في مكتب د علي صالح الدهيمان للاستشارات البيئيه بمدينة بريدة، القصيم. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع موظفي الخدمات العامة والوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى لضمان تحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلب التوظيف. سيتم مراجعة الطلبات واختيار المرشحين بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة.

e0f16ed6e36dab69.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الخليجية الأولى للصيانة والنظافة عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف على جميع جوانب الصيانة، بما في ذلك التخطيط وتوزيع المهام وتطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2-5 سنوات في مجال الصيانة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها بفعالية. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الصيانة. القدرة على إعداد خطط وبرامج العمل بكفاءة. مهارات ممتازة في توزيع المهام وإدارة فرق العمل. القدرة على تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية وتصميم برامج الصيانة الوقائية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل مشرف الصيانة ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى ضمان كفاءة واستمرارية عمليات الصيانة. عن الشركة الخليجية الأولى للصيانة والنظافة هي شركة رائدة في تقديم خدمات الصيانة والنظافة، وتلتزم بتقديم أعلى مستويات الجودة والكفاءة لعملائها. تقديم الطلبات نحن نشجع المرشحين المؤهلين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض.

e00b79d3776a92d8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نايف عبدالكريم الرخيص للمقاولات عن عامل خطوط طاقة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وإصلاح كابلات نقل وإمداد الطاقة الكهربائية، مما يضمن استمرارية وكفاءة الشبكة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم الفني للكهربائيين في أعمال الصيانة والفحص. المساعدة في تركيب كابلات نقل وتزويد الطاقة الكهربائية. المساهمة في عمليات الفحص الروتينية لأعمال الصيانة الوقائية. المساعدة في اختبار خطوط الكهرباء والمعدات الإضافية باستخدام أجهزة القراءة والاختبار، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. المساعدة في التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات المعطوبة، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص المكونات التالفة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، بما في ذلك إقامة الحواجز حول مناطق العمل لضمان السلامة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بخطوط الطاقة الكهربائية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم الفني. فهم جيد لمبادئ السلامة المهنية في بيئة العمل الكهربائية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في تبوك. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن فريق متخصص في مجال المقاولات الكهربائية، مع التركيز على الالتزام بمعايير الجودة والسلامة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. نحن نبحث عن مرشح ملتزم ومسؤول للمساهمة في مشاريع الشركة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة نايف عبدالكريم الرخيص للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

e015d3edef6aab6f.job_title: Assistant Manager Audit & Assurance Accounting & Reporting Advisory
e015d3edef6aab6f.description: About the Role Fragomen is seeking a Senior Learning and Advisory Specialist to contribute to the development and delivery of knowledge management, business advisory, and government advisory work across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region. This permanent role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The specialist will deliver consulting and advisory services and facilitate internal and external knowledge-sharing sessions. Key Responsibilities Draft, edit, update, and publish content related to immigration, mobility, and regional regulatory frameworks. Research applicable regulatory frameworks and monitor legislative, policy, and procedural developments across the MENA region. Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts to obtain, provide, and validate information, particularly concerning the practical implementation of regulatory requirements and government processes. Conduct regular quality-control reviews of content, products, and processes to ensure accuracy and efficiency. Perform strategic analysis of regulatory frameworks, including preparing international benchmarking studies and policy papers. Contribute to business advisory projects such as compliance reviews, policy drafting, and client training. Contribute to government advisory projects, including legislative analysis, stakeholder engagement, and preparation of recommendations. Utilize digital tools and proprietary systems for efficient information management and storage. Assist with the preparation and delivery of client and internal presentations, training programs, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Draft thought-leadership materials, client communications, articles, and presentations. Support business development activities, including identifying opportunities and contributing to proposals. Participate in marketing initiatives and represent the team at conferences and client meetings. Coordinate with internal and external teams, ensuring clear understanding and management of dependencies and deadlines. Prepare meeting agendas and minutes, document actions, and contribute to project plans. Support project delivery by coordinating activities, monitoring progress, and ensuring deadlines are met. Maintain accurate time records and project tracking. Undertake administrative responsibilities for team operations. Team and Work Environment The Senior Learning and Advisory Specialist will be part of the MENA Learning & Advisory Hub, a specialized, regionally based team within the broader Fragomen Knowledge Group. The team collaborates with Fragomen’s practices and Subject Matter Experts across the MENA region and with colleagues from the Knowledge Group on shared initiatives and content development. The team focuses on Knowledge Management and Awareness, Business Advisory, and Government Advisory, translating complex regulatory developments into actionable information and advice. The role may involve work in Riyadh and Al Khobar. Application Process Upon application submission, the Talent Acquisition team will review skills and experience. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an initial phone call, followed by an interview process consisting of at least two stages, one of which will be in person. A written assessment may also be required. Fragomen is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and will consider reasonable accommodations for applicants requiring support during the interview process.

e036441bc6d3c2f6.job_title: ServiceNow Support Engineer - Service & Change Management
e036441bc6d3c2f6.description: Job Purpose To provide technical and functional support for the ServiceNow platform, with a focus on Service Management and Change Management processes. The role will ensure the stability, availability, and continuous improvement of ServiceNow services while supporting ITSM operations within a banking environment. Key Responsibilities Provide L2/L3 support for ServiceNow, including incident, problem, request, and change management processes. Administer and support ServiceNow ITSM modules , ensuring reliable and efficient day-to-day operations. Manage and support Change Management workflows , approvals, change scheduling, risk assessment, and implementation processes. Troubleshoot and resolve ServiceNow incidents, defects, workflow issues, and integration-related problems. Monitor ServiceNow platform performance and identify recurring issues or opportunities for improvement. Configure and maintain ServiceNow forms, workflows, business rules, notifications, SLAs, and user access based on approved requirements. Support Change Advisory Board (CAB) activities and ensure changes follow established governance and approval procedures. Work closely with IT Operations, Infrastructure, Application Support, Development, and other technology teams to resolve ServiceNow-related issues. Support integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems and coordinate troubleshooting with relevant technical teams. Perform root cause analysis for recurring incidents and implement corrective and preventive actions. Prepare operational reports and dashboards related to incidents, requests, changes, SLAs, and service performance. Ensure ServiceNow processes and configurations align with ITSM best practices, internal controls, and banking policies . Participate in ServiceNow upgrades, releases, enhancements, testing, and deployment activities. Maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, support procedures, and configuration records. Ensure compliance with information security, audit, risk, and regulatory requirements applicable to the banking environment. Participate in 24/7 support and on-call activities , when required. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 4–7 years of experience in ServiceNow administration, support, or ITSM platform operations. Hands-on experience with ServiceNow ITSM , particularly Incident, Problem, Request, and Change Management. Strong understanding of ITIL processes and IT Service Management practices . Practical experience supporting Change Management and CAB processes . Previous experience working in a banking or financial services environment is required. Experience with ServiceNow configuration, workflows, business rules, SLAs, notifications, and access management. Good understanding of ServiceNow integrations and APIs. Experience with ServiceNow upgrades, releases, testing, and production support. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills. Good understanding of IT governance, risk, compliance, and change control within regulated environments. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) is preferred; ITIL certification is an advantage. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

e0f56a98121dcdd5.description: About State Street Investment Management State Street Investment Management (SSIM) is a global leader in asset management, providing investment and trading solutions to institutional clients worldwide. Transition Management (TM) is a strategic capability that assists clients in managing complex portfolio restructurings efficiently, with increasing integration across the broader Investment Management and Markets ecosystem. Role Overview State Street is seeking an experienced institutional sales professional for the Transition Management Sales Middle East VP role. This full-time, individual contributor position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on driving business development for the Transition Management business across the Middle East. The successful candidate will identify, develop, and secure transition management mandates from institutional investors throughout the region. This role is critical for establishing revenue growth and integrating TM into the broader institutional offering. Key Responsibilities Originate and convert transition management opportunities across institutional investors throughout the Middle East. Build and maintain relationships with Central Banks, Sovereign Wealth Funds, Family Offices, Financial Institutions, Endowments, and Foundations. Develop a strong pipeline of transition opportunities and manage prospects through the full sales cycle. Partner with existing State Street relationship teams to identify transition events and uncover new business opportunities. Collaborate with colleagues across State Street Investment Services, State Street Markets, and other State Street Investment Management teams to deliver integrated client solutions. Serve as a trusted advisor to clients undertaking manager changes, portfolio restructurings, asset allocation shifts, fund mergers, and significant cash flow events. Present transition strategies and proposals to CIOs, investment committees, trustee boards, and senior client stakeholders. Provide market intelligence on competitive activity, industry trends, and client priorities throughout the region. Represent State Street at industry events, conferences, and client meetings. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in institutional sales. Demonstrated ability to drive business development for Transition Management. Strong institutional relationships and deep knowledge of capital markets. Ability to influence sophisticated investment decision-makers. About State Street State Street holds a position as a leading global custodian, asset manager, and investment services provider. This role leverages the company's comprehensive capabilities to originate opportunities, deepen client relationships, and position Transition Management as a strategic solution for managing portfolio change. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join State Street in this full-time role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

e0fe9148c1bc30fd.description: About the Role The Ritz-Carlton is seeking a Concierge (Saudi National) for The Ritz-Carlton Residences, Diriyah, located in Riyadh. This full-time role involves responding to requests from Residence owners and their guests, ensuring their satisfaction by providing information, making arrangements, and coordinating services. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Respond to Residence owners' and guests' requests for visitor information, special arrangements, or services such as transportation, reservations, and dry cleaning. Address special requests from Residence owners and guests with unique needs and follow up to ensure satisfaction. Provide information about the property and surrounding area amenities, including special events and activities. Announce all visitors and contractors to Residence owners before granting access, permitting only authorized visitors, and implementing access into the key track system. Answer, record, and process all calls, messages, requests, questions, or concerns, contacting appropriate departments as needed. Understand and assist with owners’ reservation services (HRS). Assist with scheduling elevators for Residence owner/tenant move-ins and move-outs. Provide Bell/valet services for owners upon request for their vehicles. Perform Lobby Ambassador tasks. Review shift logs and daily memo books, documenting pertinent information. Operational Standards and Conduct Report incidents, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management; complete safety training and certifications. Adhere to all company policies and procedures, ensuring a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all Residence owners and guests according to company standards, anticipate service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and express genuine appreciation. Communicate using clear and professional language, prepare and review written documents accurately, and answer telephones with appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships, support team goals, and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Adhere to the highest standards of The Ritz-Carlton service excellence, embodying the "Gold Standards" daily. Physical Requirements Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 10 pounds without assistance. Company Culture and Values The Ritz-Carlton, part of Marriott International, is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. The company values and celebrates the diverse backgrounds, cultures, talents, and experiences of its associates. Non-discrimination is practiced on any protected basis, including disability and veteran status. Associates are empowered to be creative, thoughtful, and compassionate, contributing to the delivery of exceptional luxury service. Career Development Joining The Ritz-Carlton means becoming part of a global brand leader in luxury hospitality, where the "Gold Standards" guide daily operations and drive success. e0b494278c2e4fd3.description: We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to own the metrics and analytics layer of a growing e-commerce platform. You will be the driving force behind how merchants understand and grow their businesses through data — ensuring every report, metric, and model delivered through the platform is accurate, unified, and built to scale. You will work closely with the Platform Reports Product Manager, Platform Data Quality Engineers and partner with PMs across all product areas to unify our data models and establish a single, coherent analytical foundation. Your north star: the success of merchant reports and analytics — giving every merchant on the platform a reliable, well-documented view of their growth. What You'll Do Own the analytics direction of the Data Platform — define the vision, standards, and roadmap for metrics, models, and reporting delivered through the platform layer. Unify data models across product areas — work with the Platform Reports PM and all PMs to consolidate fragmented metric definitions into a single, governed semantic layer. Drive merchant analytics success — design, validate, and continuously improve the reports and analytics every merchant relies on to study and grow their business. Establish documentation standards — ensure every API, dataset, metric, and column is correctly named, clearly defined, and formally documented, so definitions are consistent from the warehouse to the merchant-facing report. Enable growth analysis — build the analytical foundations (cohorts, funnels, growth metrics, benchmarks) that let merchants and internal teams study growth accurately. Guard data quality and consistency — define validation rules, reconciliation checks, and metric governance so numbers match everywhere they appear. Partner cross-functionally — act as the analytical authority for the platform layer, advising engineering, product, and other analytics teams on how to build against it correctly. 5+ years of experience in data science or analytics engineering, with at least 2 years in a senior or ownership-level role. Proven experience building or governing metrics layers / semantic models (e.g., dbt, LookML, or equivalent) used by multiple teams. Strong SQL and Python; deep comfort working directly with warehouse-level data (BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or similar). Experience designing customer- or merchant-facing analytics products — dashboards, embedded reports, or analytics APIs. A strong instinct for naming, documentation, and standards — you believe a well-named column and a well-written definition are product features. Experience partnering with product managers to translate business questions into governed, reusable data models. Excellent communication skills; able to align multiple teams around a single source of truth. Nice to Have Experience in e-commerce or SaaS platforms, especially with merchant/seller analytics. Familiarity with metric stores or semantic layers at scale (Cube, dbt Semantic Layer, Metriql, etc.). Experience defining API contracts and data documentation practices (data catalogs, OpenAPI specs, column-level lineage). Statistical modeling or forecasting experience applied to growth analytics. Arabic language proficiency is a plus.

e0c593f013930119.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth. Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalized experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value. Why this role matters Customer service is evolving faster than ever. Customers expect instant, personalized support, while support teams are under constant pressure to resolve issues faster without sacrificing quality. AI is fundamentally changing how support organizations operate, and we're building the products that will define that future. As our Principal Product Manager , you'll own the strategy and direction of Lucidya's Customer Service Suite , including OmniServ, our ticketing and case management platform, mobile experience, and the AI-powered capabilities that enable support teams to work smarter. This isn't a role where you'll simply manage a backlog. You'll define where the product goes, make difficult prioritization decisions, and shape experiences that thousands of users rely on every day. You'll spend time with customers, understand how they actually work, and turn those insights into products that solve meaningful problems. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, questions assumptions, and is excited by building products where AI creates real customer value - not simply because it's the latest trend.
